title: Extraction Method B
author: SARAH SIU TZE MAK
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iadcaa6
materials: Replace the buffer with fresh buffer.

steps.title: Pre-digest samples at 56°C
steps.instruction: Incubate all samples in proteinase K‑urea buffer at 56 °C for 1 hour with continuous rotation in an oven.

steps.title: Second 12‑hour digestion
steps.instruction: Add fresh proteinase K‑urea buffer to each sample and incubate for 12 hours with rotation in an oven.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Spin the digested samples at 6000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Mix supernatant with modified PB buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a new tube and mix with modified PB buffer at a 1:8 volume ratio.

steps.title: DNA purification and elution
steps.instruction: Purify the mixture using Monarch DNA Cleanup Columns (New England Biolabs), wash, and elute DNA twice with buffer EB.

substeps.instruction: Bind DNA to Monarch column according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Wash the column with 800 µL Qiagen Buffer PE.
Elute DNA with 17 µL Qiagen Buffer EB, then incubate 5 minutes at 37 °C.
Repeat elution with a second 17 µL Buffer EB and incubate 5 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Assess extract fragment size and concentration
steps.instruction: Run a small aliquot of each extract on an Agilent 2200 TapeStation HS chip (Agilent Technologies) to estimate fragment size distribution and molar concentration before library construction.
